title: GAFC Merch: Street Smarts & Safety
body:
🎯 Street smarts ain't just about the block, fam – it's about staying safe with your firearm too! 🎯 Gloxsie 21 keeps it 💯: always treat every gun as loaded. Even Bobo Licious, after a few 'oops' moments, now double-checks that chamber like his life depends on it (because it does!). This ain't just about rules; it's about protecting your legacy, your family, your future. As the Church of Legacy preaches, wisdom and preparation keep our community strong. Rock our GAFC gear and show you stand for responsible ownership! Every tee, every hat helps us bring vital gun safety education to *our* streets. Let's make safety second nature. Shop now via link in bio! 👇
